verdicts.evidence: src/trajectory/** names no owner implementation; only src/composition/trajectory.ts adapts owners, and it exposes reads only. No owner imports Trajectory (architecture:check 0 violations, 0 new cycles).

validateWorkHistory re-parses every event through parseSchedulerEvent and checks project identity, sequence continuity, previous-digest linkage and causation-earlier; 16 tests pass over a real ProjectController/EventStore history.
The reasoning plane is read through replay/basis/frontier; the accepted frontier and the store chain are both consumed, and a frontier move is detected. 14 tests pass over a real reasoning service.
The proof plane's published-claim view and chain basis are read through the port; a non-published candidate yields UNRESOLVED_SOURCE (G-N10).
The journal store's replay and basis are read per project; a NEGATIVE_RESULT entry is resolved by id at its sequence and chain digest.

Node, edge and root ids are domain-separated canonical digests over canonical source coordinates; no UUID is generated during projection and no timestamp enters identity. G-N1/G-N2 and the identity-stability test pass.
Every receipt ground resolves through its owning plane and requires a project association; the three ground kinds resolve to PROOF, REASONING and WORKSPACE in scenario B.
Adjacency is emitted only as SAME_OWNER_SEQUENCE_SUCCESSOR with TEMPORAL_ONLY and null evidence; no relation name contains 'CAUS'; G-N5/G-N7 pass.
The vector records the actual position in Work, ProjectIR, each referenced Reasoning cell, Proof, Journal and World, plus explicit availability and completeness. No global clock is invented.
The basis is read before and after the history; a moved basis marks the window RACED (G-N11) rather than silently re-reading.
A non-genesis cut requires a validated predecessor basis; the cut excludes later events and a rebuild yields the same digest. Verified in scenario A and by G-N14.
A0's authorization is resolved from A0's own ATTEMPT_CREATED envelope_id; a later change to the task's current envelope row does not rebind it (scenario A).
The rework edge is established from the governed TASK_READY rework_provenance and points at A0's actual completed result; a forged relation with no provenance produces no edge (A-N3).
Branch, Candidate and Claim are distinct identities; a pending candidate is not an admission (B-N1) and a pending sibling never leaks through the accepted frontier (B-N9).
The accepted receipt's proposalDigest equals the proposal's, its three grounds resolve to their owners, and the resulting ProjectIR revision is read from the canonical Work event history.

Historical standing (publishedStanding) and current effective standing are separate fields; a digest difference establishes CHANGED, never invalidity, and STALE_BY_OWNER requires the owner's own semantics (G-N13).
The invariant evidenceState === ESTABLISHED_BY_OWNER_REFERENCE ⟺ evidence !== null holds across both real scenarios and every falsifier; unresolved relations appear only as diagnostics.

The maximal admitted host status is LOCAL_HOST_OBSERVATION_UNVERIFIED_FOR_CAUSAL_ADMISSION; a producer-claimed RUN_ATTEMPT_CORRELATED creates no node and no edge (G-N8). The G1-B Correlator was not modified.

No port exposes a write; the module holds no store; the barrel exports no writer; two queries leave the Work event count, the proof chain digest and the reasoning cell view unchanged, and the owner's verifyFull still passes.
Two rebuilds from the same history are byte-identical and reordering independent inputs does not move the digest (G-N17/G-N18).
21 protected evidence namespaces unchanged, 0 removed; the G1 and G1-B evidence tree hashes are identical to the baseline.
architecture:check PASS — 0 violations, 9 accepted baseline exceptions observed (unchanged).
check-public-api PASS — 0 missing, 0 changed kind, 0 added.

notRun.reason: No UI surface was modified, which the ruling permits.

notEstablished.reason: G1-B's Correlator still exposes caller-controlled trust admission surfaces and does not enforce every claimed Run/Claim/Readback relationship for all inputs. T0 records this as a forward finding and quarantines the observation; it does not fix it, because the ruling forbids fixing G1-B inside T0.

completionStateJustification: The minimum read-only contract and BOTH real Owner-backed paths work: scenario A (Work Result → Rework → New Attempt) and scenario B (Reasoning/Proof → Grounded Intent Revision) are driven through the real product machinery and reconstructed from actual owner records. Identity, source boundaries, temporal basis and unresolved-edge behaviour are proven, and all 35 negative controls are refused. 71 T0 tests pass; architecture and public-API checks pass; the owner evidence is byte-identical; and T0 introduces zero new suite failures (proven by an isolated baseline-commit comparison).

finalAcceptanceAnswer.question: Can Palimpsest reconstruct a trustworthy project evolution view from actual Work, Reasoning, Proof, Intent and Workspace owner histories, preserve the historical basis of each fact, establish only source-backed relationships, and refuse to turn unresolved observations into canonical truth?
finalAcceptanceAnswer.answer: YES, for the bounded read-only foundation T0 implements.
whatThisDoesNotProve: that every project evolution is causally understood
that multi-Agent collaboration is autonomously intelligent
that real PRIMARY execution is ready
